projects.title: EQ — Embeddable Quizzes
projects.description: Quizzes you can embed on any website. A side project about practising problem-solving before asking AI. Supabase auth with row-level security, drafts that survive a closed tab, and one widget shared by the editor preview and the embed.

projects.title: Museum Planning Tool
projects.description: Group planning for a museum: create a poll, invite people, vote together. I built the backend with Next.js and Payload CMS: permissions, simultaneous votes, WhatsApp notifications. About 100 polls are created each month.

projects.title: Healthcare Checkout
projects.description: A checkout that keeps working when things break: payment retries, form data that survives errors, a fallback when the address service is down. Conversion went up 15%, and it stayed up through two Cloudflare outages.

projects.title: Political Party Website
projects.description: Political party portal with 80+ subsites. Built the registration, donation, petition and shop flows, and made the pages fast again.

projects.title: Product Feeds Plugin
projects.description: A CMS plugin that turns a product catalogue into Meta and Google feeds. I designed and built the interface: field mapping, live preview, and progress while the feed generates.

projects.title: Shared Payload Plugins
projects.description: Moved 5+ plugins that were being copied between projects into npm packages. Updates now reach every project up to 3x faster.
